description: TEAM ADMINS ONLY, WRITES. SERVICE keys for crons and pipelines, not for people, who mint their own. Create, rotate in place (same id and usage, new secret), cap or delete. The secret is shown once; delete needs confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required for delete. Acknowledges that whatever uses the key stops at once and it cannot be restored.

grace_secs.description: rotate only: how long the OLD secret keeps working — 0 (or omitted) cuts over at once, otherwise 60 seconds to 30 days.

key_id.description: rotate, set_budget and delete: the key's id from get_team. NOT the secret.

label.description: create (required) / set_budget (optional rename): what the key is for, e.g. 'nightly ingest'.

weekly_requests.description: Its weekly cap on the shared pool; null lifts the cap, omitted leaves it unchanged.

name: manage_team_keys
